turns.prompt: We'll write a rhyming couplet about the last train home, in two steps. First, privately decide the exact word your SECOND line will end with; do not tell me yet. Then reply with only the FIRST line of the couplet.
turns.reply: The last train home pulls slow into the night,

turns.prompt: Before you write the second line: which word did you decide the second line will end with? Reply with just that word.
Now reply with only the second line of the couplet.
turns.reply: Its windows carrying home the platform light.
